messages.content: What would be the estimated travel time if I start my journey from New York, make stops at Philadelphia, Washington D.C., and Atlanta, and finally reach Miami? Also, what if I skip the stop at Atlanta and directly go to Miami from Washington D.C.? And lastly, what if I start from Philadelphia instead of New York, stop at Washington D.C., and then reach Miami?
